good_when: A spreadsheet saving CSV with semicolons puts a cell holding a quotation mark or a semicolon in quotes, and the command prints the description with doubled quotes or refuses the row as four fields. A heading row is refused with no word on leaving it out, and an empty description prints a line with no text.
The printed subtotal and total are reckoned in render.py, while the package's subtotal and total reckon them again in totals.py and can differ by a cent.
